prayerExcerpt.en-US: I have been crucified with Christ; yet I live, no longer I, but Christ lives in me.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Com Cristo, eu fui pregado na cruz. Eu vivo, mas não eu, é Cristo que vive em mim.

meta.face: Paul: a Japanese man of about thirty-three with a lean, long face — a high forehead, high, flat cheekbones, a slim, straight nose with a low bridge, narrow single-lidded dark eyes under fine straight brows and a firm, narrow chin; clean-shaven, short-cropped black hair, lips slightly parted as if preaching, his gaze raised. Louis: a Japanese boy of twelve with a flat, round little face — plump round cheeks, a tiny snub nose, narrow crescent eyes that nearly close as he smiles, thin arched brows and a small pointed chin; glossy black hair tied back in a short tail and a small, joyful smile.
meta.basis: No portrait exists. Butler gives Paul Miki as a noble Japanese and an eminent preacher of thirty-three, and three boys among the twenty-six, the youngest only twelve; the Jesuit black and the crucifix follow the devotional images, the boy's dress is a choice.
